\[
\alpha(x+y+z-6)+\beta(2x+3y+4z+5)=0.
\]
Since the plane must also contain \((1,1,1)\), substitute \(x=y=z=1\):
\[
\alpha(3-6)+\beta(2+3+4+5)=0.
\]
So
\[
-3\alpha+14\beta=0 \implies 3\alpha=14\beta.
\]
Choose \(\alpha=14,\ \beta=3\). Then the plane is
\[
14(x+y+z-6)+3(2x+3y+4z+5)=0.
\]
Simplify:
\[
14x+14y+14z-84+6x+9y+12z+15=0
\]
\[
20x+23y+26z-69=0.
\]
The coefficients have gcd \(1\), and \(A=20>0\).

The answer is \(\boxed{20x+23y+26z-69=0}\).
